description: A polished 32x32 pixel art miniature LANDSCAPE emblem for a cozy fishing game UI. A vivid autumn lake landscape, NOT a house object. Broad sparkling azure lake occupies lower half. Large saturated red-orange maple tree on left shore; a VERY SMALL dark brown hut and tiny dock beneath it. One deep purple mountain and warm golden sky behind lake. Bright saturated red/orange foliage and blue water, dark brown hut roof, NO pale beige roof. Clear layered scenic composition. Strict crisp pixel clusters, rich clean colors, three distinct shades per material, dark warm selective contour, a readable simple silhouette at tiny original size. Slightly elevated side view, the whole miniature scene contained within canvas with one pixel clear margin, transparent outer background. No button frame, no text, no people, no animals, no fish. Beautiful handcrafted 16-bit game icon matching cream parchment and carved wood UI.
negative_description: text, letters, numbers, watermark, border, UI frame, photograph, blur, messy dithering, tiny noise, cropped edges, gray or white background, muddy colors
